title: How cold is each one?
prompt: Place each target by its temperature.

items.label: Pluto mean temperature
items.fact: NASA lists Pluto's mean temperature at -225 °C.

items.label: Neptune mean temperature
items.fact: For Neptune, NASA's temperature is measured at the atmospheric level with pressure equal to Earth's sea-level pressure.

items.label: Saturn mean temperature
items.fact: NASA lists Saturn's mean temperature at -140 °C using an atmospheric pressure level comparable to sea level on Earth.

items.label: Mars mean temperature
items.fact: NASA gives Mars a mean temperature of -65 °C.

items.label: FDA freezer temperature
items.fact: The FDA says a freezer should be kept at 0 °F (-18 °C); freezing stops most bacteria from growing but does not kill them.

items.label: FDA refrigerator limit
items.fact: The FDA recommends keeping a refrigerator at or below 40 °F (4 °C) to help prevent foodborne illness.
